data.body: [P2] Keep these `CallbackTimeoutException` candidates pending when the status read fails or returns `RUNNING`. The callback endpoint can close during execution completion before `GetDurableExecution` reflects the terminal state; appending and clearing here prevents later complete terminal history from reconciling that race, so an otherwise valid run fails. Retain the candidates until terminal history or polling termination, then reconcile or report them, and add failed/RUNNING-then-terminal regression cases.
